chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Al-Amraki ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Ja'far, who said:

I asked Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) about the man who gives from his zakat of dirhams [in the form of] dinars, and from his zakat of dinars [in the form of] dirhams, by the value. Is that permissible? He (peace be upon him) said: There is no problem with it.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no problem with it

ai.seo_question: Can I pay my silver zakat with gold money?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the permissibility of paying zakat in a different currency than the one held, provided the exchange reflects current market value (al-qimah) rather than a fixed weight ratio. This ruling highlights the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding monetary zakat, accommodating changes in currency value and facilitating ease for the payer while ensuring the recipient receives equivalent value.
